caption: The drawing depicts a brown statue of a lion standing upright on its hind legs, with its right forepaw raised and resting on a large, curved ornamental scroll. The lion's left forepaw is positioned slightly behind the scroll, bent at the elbow. The statue is mounted on a rectangular base, with additional scrollwork and decorative elements beneath and around the lion’s feet and the main scroll. The lion’s head is turned slightly to its left, and its tail curves sharply upward and to the left. The background is a plain, off-white color with no additional objects or features present.
title: Woodcarving of a Lion
